summary: Lewis Hamilton faces redemption at Circuit of the Americas as Kimi Antonelli's Ferrari team hunts the championship-clinching victory that slipped away in Singapore. Carlos Sainz and McLaren loom as dark horses threatening to disrupt Ferrari's coronation coronation, their recent pace gains creating unpredictable tire and fuel strategies for Sunday's 56-lap battle. A win for Antonelli would seal the driver's title with three races remaining, while a Hamilton victory could reignite championship hopes and erase the strategic miscalculation that handed his rival the advantage.
